# /uses/ is generated by scripts/build-blog.mjs from this file. Sources: the resume skills, the work
# experience in src/constants/index.js, and the stacks of the published articles.
# A tool links to every published article whose tags or "| Layer | Choice | Why |" table mention
# its name or one of its `match` aliases, plus any slugs in `articles`; `skip` removes slugs.
# `hosts` also links articles whose live link is on that domain (vercel.app). `at` names the jobs
# where he used it (shown as "At Rivo", linked to the resume).
title: "Tools I Use"
description: "The languages, frameworks, AI and voice tools, data stores, and growth stack Anirudh Vasudevan uses at Rivo and in his projects, linked to each write-up."
date: 2026-10-17
slug: uses
headline: Tools I use.
standfirst: The stack I reach for at Rivo and in my own projects. Where I wrote up a project that uses a tool, the tool links to that write-up.
